description: This PHP file defines a class GlobalConfigSubscriber that listens to HTTP request events in a Symfony-based application to set configuration flags like internationalization and date formatting based on query parameters.

classes.name: GlobalConfigSubscriber
classes.description: A subscriber class that handles 'request' events and updates configuration settings based on query parameters.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array of events this subscriber listens to, specifically the kernel request event.

methods.name: onRequestEvent
methods.description: Event handler that extracts configuration flags from the request's query parameters and sets them in the Config.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Private method that sets a configuration key-value pair and logs any exceptions encountered.
